About the job
Kontor is a fast-growing fintech for small business banking with 140,000 customers. We want customer experience to become a company-wide discipline and are looking for an Interim Head of CX for nine months.

What you will do
• Build the CX function with a team of six (research, insights, journey owners)
• Set up a Voice of the Customer programme with NPS and transactional surveys, including closed-loop follow-up
• Define the CX strategy and the target experience for onboarding, payments and support
• Run journey analytics with product and data teams and prioritise CX improvements in the roadmap
• Work closely with customer support and product leadership

What you bring
• 8+ years in customer experience, at least 3 in a lead role
• Proven experience with NPS or VoC programmes and journey management
• Experience in banking, fintech or another digital service
• Excellent stakeholder management, English fluent, German a plus

Terms
• 9 months, start November 2026
• Two days a week in our Berlin office
• €1,200 per day
